sections.html: The Black Diamond is a variety of Potamotrygon leopoldi that originates from the upper Rio Xingu in Brazil. These stingrays attain a maximum size of about 40-60 cm disc width.
German bred Black Diamonds are available, sorted by pair. The fish have code 282412 on the stocklist. Aquarium Glaser exclusively supplies the wholesale trade.

The poison of these stingrays is quite strong. A Potamotrygon will never sting its keeper out of aggression, and the animals become very tame. However, even the tamest animals can be frightened by chance, and then it is possible that they sting.
These hints should not be an argument against keeping stingrays. Anyone who has a tank spacious enough should try keeping them at least once in a lifetime.
